text.content:
The kid from Santo Domingo.

Role: Edgerunner
Location: Megabuilding H4, Santo Domingo
Known for: Rumored to have made a last stand in the Corporate Center in 2076

Spoilers for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners. Born in the back of a speeding ambulance to Gloria Martinez, an EMT who delivered him herself, David grew up in Santo Domingo hungry for something bigger, always hanging around edgerunners and ripperdocs.

In 2076 an Arasaka and Militech incident wrecked part of the Corporate Center. The media called it terrorism; rumor says it was David Martinez's last stand.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.35
